en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a military guardhouse complex with low and higher plastered buildings with tiled roofs surrounding a courtyard. Soldiers in uniform stand in formation near a striped guard post, while civilians, including children, walk in the open square. An arched gateway on the left bears German text, and printed captions in red at the bottom identify the view and publisher.
